name: Cutlassfly
look: a huge teal-and-brown dragonfly with huge orange eyes and four long steel knife blades for wings, hovering with six legs dangling and a blade at the tip of its long tail
entry: Its wings are blades sharp enough to slice falling leaves in two. It hovers perfectly still over rivers, then darts away faster than the eye can follow, leaving cut reeds behind it.
how: Wild: rare by rivers and in swamps.
